usage_policy.refresh: At each new engineering session and relevant MCP milestone
usage_policy.promotion: Requires scope-specific live evidence, automated checks and documented limitations

capabilities.limitations: Native observable data only; not every hover or graphical detail
Available chart history and verified futures aliases; independently synchronize assets and timeframes
Start, one-bar step and stop verified on disposable ES 15M QA only; not authorized on protected layouts

Manual restoration verified with three stable baseline reads. Explicit discard-consent guard passed offline tests; no automatic dirty-layout reload has been tested live. Reload remains disabled by default and requires separate per-run operator approval on the disposable ES QA layout. Change attribution is incomplete.
Guest light-check is not equivalent to actual editor compilation

Read-only native Pine lines and labels remain live-verified on YM 30M. Unambiguous graphics collection coverage is handled offline. Native X is preserved. The earlier numeric-index time claim is retracted because projected labels can use a different coordinate basis. Do not treat output timestamps from the older running Pilot as validated event times. Hover-only text and full visual fidelity remain unverified.

coordinate_enrichment.method: Native graphics X is preserved. Numerically matching an OHLC index cannot independently establish the native X coordinate basis. Absolute time is withheld.
coordinate_enrichment.limitations: Fail-closed null timestamps live-verified on seven lines and seven labels. Independent native X-to-time provenance remains unresolved.

prior_live_evidence.verification: Read-only MCP graphics and independent OHLC
prior_live_evidence.limitations: Loaded index timestamps matched independent OHLC. Future projections, unavailable collections and complete visual fidelity remain unverified live.

pagination_evidence.description: Coverage describes accessible native collections, not pagination. Per-study next_offset and all_items_returned_in_this_call distinguish partial pagination from a full single-call read.
pagination_evidence.limitations: Separate pagination calls are not atomic. Live verification is scoped to YM 30M SMT v0.11.

live_evidence.timestamps: All unresolved native coordinates returned null

capabilities.limitations: Some projected graphics and hover-only details still need manual evidence
Live verified on C123 and SMT v0.11 only. Native X-to-time mapping, hover details and visual fidelity remain unverified. Direct ChatGPT connector action requires tool-list refresh.

Live verified for present studies on two YM 30M charts. Stale-ID and missing-graphics distinctions passed offline tests but were not separately live verified. Chart state may change after capture. Direct ChatGPT action requires connector refresh.

Live verified on C123 v0.3 YM1! 30M. Screenshot is viewport-only; matching bracket reads are not atomic and cannot exclude transient changes. Native-to-screen pixel and timestamp mapping remain unverified. Hover-only details and signal correctness are not certified. Requires MCP restart and connector refresh for direct access.

Live verified on YM1! 15M C123 v0.4. Five native candle-index-to-chart-coordinate roundtrips and public time matches were observed. These do not prove that Pine drawing X shares the candle index domain. Drawing-to-time and drawing-to-pixel mapping remain unverified. Numeric overlaps are not mapping evidence. Pre/post snapshots are not atomic. Requires MCP restart and connector refresh for direct access.

Read-only, exact target/layout/study-ID and study-name guards. Bracketed graphics snapshots automatically correlate C1/C2/C3 role labels to projected clock captions by exact native X within one study; missing/duplicate clocks are explicitly unverified. Optional saved script ID/version/title/SHA256 proof DOES NOT prove that the loaded study is bound to that version. Native drawing X to absolute time/pixels, distinct C123 event grouping, visuals/hover fidelity and signal correctness are NOT established. Supports 1-200 items per kind, complete labels required, and refuses correlation after chart/graphics changes. Requires scoped live acceptance.

validation.integrated_live_canary: Replay start/step/stop verified; automatic reload safely held
validation.note: Automated tests alone never establish live trading or Pine correctness
